name: inkling
description: Read and manage Inkling notes, todos, discussions and sourced answers.
author: Buildersoft LLC

fields.label: API Key
fields.helpText: Create a key in Inkling Settings > Integrations.

tools.name: inkling.usage
tools.description: Read account usage and key information.

tools.name: inkling.list_notes
tools.description: List notes with filters and cursor pagination.

limit.description: Page size; the API clamps it to 1-50, and 0 or less means the default of 20.

tools.name: inkling.get_note
tools.description: Read a note and its stored revision.

tools.name: inkling.list_todos
tools.description: List todos; only the done view accepts a cursor and limit is refused. Open and assigned can be truncated.

cursor.description: Previous next_cursor for the done view only. Omit for the first page or other views; an empty string is treated as omitted.

tools.name: inkling.ask
tools.description: Start an asynchronous sourced answer or continue a discussion.

discussion_id.description: A discussion to continue; omit to start a new one.

tools.name: inkling.get_answer
tools.description: Read or wait for an asynchronous answer.

limit.description: Page size; the API clamps it to 1-50, and 0 or less means the default of 20.

tools.name: inkling.get_discussion
tools.description: Read a discussion and its turns.

tools.name: inkling.create_note
tools.description: Create a note; share_with can invite collaborators. The request may be at most 8 MiB.

body.description: Markdown; omit for an empty note.

properties.description: Note properties; omit a member for none.

lead.description: me for the key's account; omit for none.

sources.description: Sources named by the [n] marks in the body.

share_with.description: People already on one of the account's own notes to invite.

tools.name: inkling.update_note
tools.description: Update a note; replacing its body requires if_match. An empty property member clears it; the request may be at most 8 MiB.

title.description: New title; it cannot be empty.

body.description: Markdown replacing the whole body; requires if_match.

properties.description: Omit a member to keep it; an empty string clears it.

lead.description: me, the key of a person on the note, or empty to clear.

sources.description: Sources named by the [n] marks in the body.

if_match.description: Stored note etag, required for body replacement.

sources.description: Sources named by the [n] marks in the body.

tools.name: inkling.archive_note
tools.description: Archive a note for the current account.

tools.name: inkling.create_todo
tools.description: Create a todo in the Inbox or an editable note.

note_id.description: Note to put it in; omit for the Inbox.

repeat.description: daily, weekdays, weekly-1 through weekly-7, monthly-1 through monthly-31, or yearly-MM-DD.

tools.name: inkling.complete_todo
tools.description: Complete a todo; repeating todos may create a new occurrence.
